pages.text: A wagon stool is a dedicated part occupying one cargo slot. It can only be placed on wagons. Use its seat to sit; sneak to dismount or remove a stool.$(br2)Boarding checks occupancy and the rider’s full clearance, including cargo, covers, world blocks and Sable structures. Stools do not control the wagon.

Eligible mobs approaching an empty stool can board automatically; players cannot. Lead a mob and use an empty stool with a lead in hand to seat it and recover the lead.$(br2)Unseated entities do not follow a moving deck and may slide off. Maids need the appropriate riding task or will leave the seat.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: The top row uses matching planks and determines the stool’s wood.
